Keep back gesture on index side
The alphabet index only blocks the back gesture near the letter you touched.
Double-tap an empty area of the home screen to lock the screen.
Screen lock is turned off in the system accessibility settings.
Use an accessibility service to lock the screen?

Android only lets apps lock the screen through an accessibility service. Strata\'s service does one thing: it locks the screen when you double-tap an empty area of the home screen. It cannot read what is on your screen, does not watch what you do, and sends nothing anywhere. You turn it on in the next screen and can turn it off there at any time.

Not allowed. Strata needs notification access to show badges.
If Android says this setting is restricted, open Strata\'s App info, tap the menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Notification badges aren\'t available on this device. Android doesn\'t allow notification access on low-memory devices with this Android version.
Allow Strata to see your notifications?

To show badges, Strata needs notification access. Android then lets Strata see all your notifications, including their text. Strata only counts them per app: it never reads, stores, logs or backs up what they say, and it has no internet access. You allow access on the next screen and can turn it off there at any time.
Show up to 5 matching contacts below the apps.
Permission needed. Strata can\'t read your contacts, so contact search is off.
Allow Contacts in Strata\'s permissions, then turn this on again.

Strata will ask Android for permission to read your contacts. Names and photos are looked up only while you type in search. Nothing is copied, stored, logged or sent anywhere, and Strata has no internet access.
Strata stops recording which apps you open. History stays on this phone and is kept for 30 days.
Removes recent apps and usage ranking now.
Strata isn\'t your home app. Tap to set it.
Switch to another home app first, then uninstall
Strata is your home app. Pick another home app in the system settings, then come back here and Strata\'s uninstall dialog opens.
Its container at the end of the app list. Nothing about it is stored by Strata.
Choose, edit, import and share themes
Which apps have a themed icon and which don\'t
This theme doesn\'t tint icons, so apps show their normal icons. Glyphs and the desaturated fallback are only used when icons are tinted.
Highlighted apps have no glyph and no themed icon of their own, so they are shown desaturated.
Off: only the desaturated apps. The list holds app names and package names only.
What Strata may use and why
Strata has no internet access. It can\'t send anything anywhere.
Everything Strata keeps stays on this phone: your favourites, names, hidden apps, themes and app history.
Counts notifications per app for badges. What they say is never read, stored or sent.
Finds contacts while you type in search. Nothing is copied or stored.
Locks the screen when you double-tap empty space on home. It can\'t read your screen.
Libraries and fonts used by Strata

Strata Launcher collects no data. It has no internet access, no analytics, no ads and no accounts. Your settings, themes and app history are stored only on this phone and, if you turn it on, in your own Android backup. Notification contents, contact data and searches are never stored.
